rationale.unchanged: After 11 rounds of refinement, the hint has converged to a stable state that successfully guides students toward the paper's core concepts (attraction/repulsion, anti-symmetry, training-time evolution) while preserving the specific mathematical innovations as the conceptual residual. The student consistently achieves scores around 3.4, capturing the general approach but missing the precise 'drifting field' formulation, pushforward distribution framework, and stop-gradient training mechanism - which appears to be the irreducible novelty of the paper.
